    direction LR

    class Safelist {
        -Set~TagName~ tagNames
        -Map~TagName, Set~AttributeKey~~ attributes
        -Map~TagName, Map~AttributeKey, AttributeValue~~ enforcedAttributes
        -Map~TagName, Map~AttributeKey, Set~Protocol~~~ protocols
        -boolean preserveRelativeLinks
        +Safelist()
        +Safelist(Safelist copy)
        +none()$ Safelist
        +simpleText()$ Safelist
        +basic()$ Safelist
        +basicWithImages()$ Safelist
        +relaxed()$ Safelist
        +addTags(String... tags) Safelist
        +removeTags(String... tags) Safelist
        +addAttributes(String tag, String... attributes) Safelist
        +removeAttributes(String tag, String... attributes) Safelist
        +addEnforcedAttribute(String tag, String attribute, String value) Safelist
        +removeEnforcedAttribute(String tag, String attribute) Safelist
        +preserveRelativeLinks(boolean preserve) Safelist
        +preserveRelativeLinks() boolean
        +addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols) Safelist
        +removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols) Safelist
        +isSafeTag(String tag) boolean
        +isSafeAttribute(String tagName, Element el, Attribute attr) boolean
        +getEnforcedAttributes(String tagName) Attributes
        -getProtocolValue(Element el, Attribute attr) String
        -isSafeProtocol(String value, Set~Protocol~ protocols) boolean
        -shouldAbsUrl(TagName tag, AttributeKey key) boolean
        -isValidAnchor(String value)$ boolean
    }

    class TypedValue {
        <<abstract>>
        -String value
        +hashCode() int
        +equals(Object obj) boolean
        +toString() String
    }
    class TagName {
        ~valueOf(String value)$ TagName
    }
    class AttributeKey {
        ~valueOf(String value)$ AttributeKey
    }
    class AttributeValue {
        ~valueOf(String value)$ AttributeValue
    }
    class Protocol {
        ~valueOf(String value)$ Protocol
    }

    class Cleaner {
        -Safelist safelist
        +Cleaner(Safelist safelist)
    }
    class Jsoup {
        +clean(String bodyHtml, String baseUri, Safelist safelist)$ String
        +clean(String bodyHtml, Safelist safelist)$ String
        +clean(String bodyHtml, String baseUri, Safelist safelist, OutputSettings outputSettings)$ String
        +isValid(String bodyHtml, Safelist safelist)$ boolean
    }

    class Element
    class Attribute
    class Attributes
    class Validate {
        <<utility>>
    }
    class Normalizer {
        <<utility>>
    }
    class StringUtil {
        <<utility>>
    }

    TypedValue <|-- TagName
    TypedValue <|-- AttributeKey
    TypedValue <|-- AttributeValue
    TypedValue <|-- Protocol

    Safelist +-- TypedValue : nested
    Safelist +-- TagName : nested
    Safelist +-- AttributeKey : nested
    Safelist +-- AttributeValue : nested
    Safelist +-- Protocol : nested

    Safelist "1" o-- "*" TagName : tagNames
    Safelist "1" o-- "*" AttributeKey : attributes
    Safelist "1" o-- "*" AttributeValue : enforcedAttributes
    Safelist "1" o-- "*" Protocol : protocols

    Cleaner "1" --> "1" Safelist : safelist
    Jsoup ..> Safelist : clean / isValid
    Jsoup ..> Cleaner : creates

    Safelist ..> Element : isSafeAttribute / getProtocolValue
    Safelist ..> Attribute : isSafeAttribute
    Safelist ..> Attributes : getEnforcedAttributes creates
    Safelist ..> Validate : argument checks
    Safelist ..> Normalizer : lowerCase
    Safelist ..> StringUtil : hasHttpScheme
    TypedValue ..> Validate : notNull
